sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: Cinematic photograph. One ivory paper boat, pointed open hull, low central fold, on a scratched dark wooden workbench beside blank paper. Warm amber sidelight, deep blue shadows, low camera, realistic paper fibres, entire boat visible, shallow depth of field.
